Review the property description and tell us what is good and what is bad about it and list its key takeaways.

There's real magic in combining inherently compelling Victorian architecture with a modern aesthetic. Add in an extraordinary multi-level garden & the result is the undeniable elegance of 444 29th St. The front of the home is light-filled w/ a seamless connection between living, dining & kitchen. Newly updated kitchen w/ quartz counters & upgraded appliances. A lg dining rm has a bay of windows &, when paired w/ the adjacent living rm, provides an ideal space to entertain. 2 lg bdrms on this level are at the rear. Both w/ lg closets & walk out to the garden. Stylishly remodeled full bath on this level. 3rd bdrm/2nd full bath are located on the ground floor - perfect as a guest rm, home office, fitness area, etc. The enormous garden occupies an extra deep lot & is beautifully landscaped & terraced. Laundry/storage rm, 1-car garage pkg, Tesla solar panels. Prime, flat part of Noe Valley - short walk to all that Noe has to offer. Steps from the J-Church & convenient to shuttles/freeways.

The property description is compelling and provides a clear picture of the home's features and benefits. The combination of Victorian architecture with a modern aesthetic is a unique selling point. The multi-level garden adds an extra layer of appeal and the seamless connection between the living, dining, and kitchen areas create an ideal space for entertaining. The updated kitchen with quartz counters and upgraded appliances is also a plus. The 2 large bedrooms and stylishly remodeled full bath on the main level are great features. The third bedroom and second full bath on the ground floor provide flexibility for use as a guest room, home office, or fitness area. The enormous garden, Tesla solar panels, and convenient location are all attractive features. The home is 3,200 sq ft and has 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The prime location in Noe Valley is steps away from the J-Church and close to restaurants, shops, and other amenities. Overall, the key takeaways from the property description are the unique combination of Victorian and modern elements, the spacious and stylish layout, the beautiful garden, and the prime location. The home offers a lot of potential for further improvement and customization to suit the buyer's needs. Noe Valley is a charming and vibrant community with a unique character, making it an ideal place to live.
